rinks.name: Standard rink
rinks.describe: Three periods on the usual ice.

rinks.name: First to three
rinks.describe: No clock. The first team to three goals wins.

rinks.name: The pond
rinks.describe: A small, slippery rink. One line each and no changes: everyone plays the whole game.

rinks.name: Heavy puck
rinks.describe: The puck is slow and dies quickly. Keep passes short and shoot from close.

rinks.name: Lively puck
rinks.describe: The puck is fast and bounces hard off the boards and the posts.

rinks.name: Big nets
rinks.describe: Wider nets: more goals, and a hard night for goalies.

rinks.name: The long sheet
rinks.describe: A longer rink: more room to carry the puck, and a longer way back.

rinks.name: Thin air
rinks.describe: A rink in the hills. Everyone tires half as fast again: change lines often.

rinks.name: Small nets
rinks.describe: Narrow nets: goals are scarce, and the first one matters.
